### Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, learners will be able to:

- Understand what an LLM is and differences between properietary and open-weight models
- Explain key features of Agentic AI workflow (permissions, context engineering, tool-calling, system prompt, skills etc)
- Understand pros- and cons- of various context engineering techniques.
:::

## Lectures and Materials

Tentative

- Introduction to LLMs
- Agentic AI core concepts
- Agentic AI fundamentals through the lens of a AI coding harness
